description: Every page address a website publishes: reads robots.txt, follows its sitemaps (and sitemap indexes), and returns the URLs with last-modified dates, newest first, optionally only under one path (e.g. /blog/). Also returns the robots rules that apply to crawlers. Plan a crawl or spot new pages cheaply. Price: $0.003 in USDC per call (x402 or prepaid credits). In the free trial.

path.description: Only return pages under this path, e.g. /blog/.

url.description: Any address on the site, e.g. https://example.com.

name: sitemap

robots.description: robots.txt status (ok/none/unreachable), sitemaps, and the Allow/Disallow rules that apply to us.

total.description: URLs found before the path filter and limit.

unreadSitemaps.description: Nested sitemaps not read because of the per-call fetch cap.
